reviews.name: J M
reviews.text:
I’ve been doing physio and mobility work with Edmund at Regen Performance, and it’s been a game changer. He really opened my eyes to how everything in the body is connected — starting from the feet all the way up.
What stood out most is how he was able to identify the root cause of my pain instead of just treating the surface symptoms like what most physiotherapists practice. Once he addressed that, the pain went away completely, and my mobility improved drastically.
Edmund’s approach is both detailed and holistic — he helps you understand how your body works and teaches you how to move better for the long term. I feel lighter, more stable, and more aware of my movement now.
Highly recommend Regen Performance to anyone dealing with pain, stiffness, or wanting to move and feel better overall.

reviews.name: Ming
reviews.text:
I was struggling with intractable chronic pain for over a year — pain so intense and persistent that it completely disrupted my daily life.
I’m deeply grateful to have subsequently found Issac. My recovery journey was far from linear though, and there were periods when my condition actually worsened. Through it all, Issac remained patient and supportive. He consistently checked in between sessions and thoughtfully adjusted my rehabilitation exercises to match my changing needs.
Issac also takes the extra step of documenting and recording each prescribed exercise, sending me the videos for easy reference. This has been incredibly helpful in ensuring that I practice them correctly and consistently.
Thanks to his expertise and dedication, I’ve been able to gradually regain strength, confidence, and a sense of normalcy. Working with Issac has truly helped me reclaim my quality of life.

reviews.name: Joanne Pizel
reviews.text: I've been working out with Issac and Hans from ReGen Performance for over 3 years and they are the BEST! They have made me adore strength training💪. They know so much more than typical trainers about how the body works and how to modify movements based on my specific anatomy and flexibility etc. They are both training as Oesteopaths in their spare time as they are just so passionate about how to improve their clients outcomes. I'm a 51 year old female and am stronger and fitter than I've ever been in my life. I feel great and know that a huge part of it is because of these two trainers. I've seen the other ReGen trainers with their clients too and they seem fantastic as well. I would 100% recommend!

reviews.name: Christina Liew
reviews.text:
I had been living with neck, shoulder and lower back pain for many years before I started training with Shaun. What stood out to me was how he took the time to understand my body and pinpoint the specific issues, rather than simply putting me through a standard workout.
He identified the different muscles that needed to be strengthened, worked on them individually, and then helped me learn how to coordinate them properly. Over time, this has made a real difference to my everyday mobility and how I feel physically.
I have been training with Shaun for over a year now, and I am genuinely in a much better physical state—with greater strength, endurance and confidence in my movement.
I am very grateful for his knowledge, patience and personalised approach. I highly recommend Shaun to anyone looking for a thoughtful and effective functional training coach.

reviews.name: Suyeon Koo
reviews.text: I used to train with Tan Long for general fitness and strength training, so I knew he specialises in chronic pain and has a lot of experience working with older adults. When my mother-in-law (69) continued to struggle with knee pain despite having received PRP injections for meniscus tears and early osteoarthritis, I didn't hesitate to bring her to him. What stood out was how he assessed her whole body rather than just the knees, quickly identifying that poor hip and ankle function was overloading her joints. He explained everything clearly, and by the end of the session she was already moving more comfortably with a practical program to follow at home. Having trained with him myself, I'd recommend him without hesitation — especially for older adults dealing with persistent or complex pain.

reviews.name: Min Koh
reviews.text:
Before working with Coach Tan Long, I was constantly battling pain—my left hip/foot tension kept me from sleeping through the night, and my left knee ached when I climbed stairs. After just a few months of his personalized training, these issues are gone. I can now sleep soundly and climb stairs pain-free!
As someone who practices advanced yoga (arm balances, handstands, deep backbends and splits), I frequently ran into frustrating aches and pains. Coach Tan Long is incredibly insightful. He assessed my Range of Motion (ROM), taught me specific targeted workouts, and meticulously checked my body's adaptation. He was able to pinpoint the root cause and effectively relieve the tension.
Over the past three months, I’ve seen remarkable improvements in my foundation, including better overall posture (reduced anterior pelvic tilt and knee hyperextension). My squats have improved considerably, and I no longer rely on lower back compensation.
Coach Tan Long is a must-see PT Coach for anyone who wants to improve their quality of life, daily function, or athletic performance. For those of us, like me, who need to understand the Why’s (science & logic) behind the assessment, exercise, adjustment - he is absolutely the best resource available!

reviews.name: Elaine
reviews.text:
I’ve been seeing Hans for 12 sessions to work on my knee issues and I’m thankful for the progress so far. He focuses a lot on proper realignment and improving my movement patterns rather than just treating the pain temporarily.
Through the sessions, he helped me understand how my body moves and what may be causing stress on my knees. The exercises were practical, targeted, and adjusted according to my condition each time. I also appreciate that he explains things clearly and makes sure I’m doing the movements correctly so that I don’t aggravate the pain.
Overall, I feel more confident moving and exercising without hurting my knees further. Highly recommend Hans to anyone dealing with pain issues or wanting to improve their movement safely!

reviews.name: Siew Lian Tay
reviews.text:
For months, knee osteoarthritis made everyday activities a struggle. Walking short distances, squatting, climbing stairs, and even turning in bed caused pain and swelling. I tried TCM treatments and medication for pain relief but the relief never lasted. Meeting Tan Long changed all these.
He did a thorough assessment and showed me how to reduce the inflammation in my knee. With his targetted rehabilitation exercises, the swelling eased noticeably within a week and I could walk more comfortably again.
What sets Tan Long apart is his patience and attention to detail. He always corrects my form, makes sure I move safely and gently pushes me to improve without ever making me feel rushed. Thanks to his persistence, I regained more flexibility, mobility and strength.
Today, I can walk, squat and climb stairs without difficulty. I am now continuing to work with him to build stronger legs, glutes and arms so that I can get even stronger overall.
I am grateful for Tan Long's expertise, dedication and genuine care. Highly recommend him for anyone looking for a knowledgeable and results-driven personal trainer!

reviews.name: Yuanhong Tan
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Jensen! I’ve been training with him for over 1.5 years, and his approach to personal training is incredibly refreshing. He focuses entirely on overall lifestyle, long-term well-being, and injury prevention rather than just chasing aesthetic body shapes or heavy gym metrics.
What I appreciate most is how dialed-in he is to my current physical state. During my half-marathon prep, he adjusted our training items based on my running volume and recovery. When work gets intense and I'm sitting for too long, he immediately pivots to target office posture and muscle tightness. Jensen is the perfect fit for anyone who wants to feel better, move better, and live a healthier, pain-free life.

reviews.name: Steph Gee
reviews.text: I’ve found Isaac to be incredibly attentive, and he tailors his functional training very thoughtfully to address where I’m weak while helping me build the strength needed to stay healthy and age well. He is constantly upgrading his knowledge and skills, which gives me a lot of confidence in how he manages and advises on my condition. I would highly recommend him, especially for anyone with pre-existing conditions who wants a safe, well-considered approach to training.

reviews.name: Derek Low
reviews.text: Have been working out under Kennard’s guidance for more than a year now. I am not a very active person but with Ken’s help I can see my weight and health improved body composition has also improved. He also uses apps to interface with my weighting machine and other health devices to all us to track and monitor my progress. Will continue to work with him to continue improving and maintaining my fitness level.

reviews.name: Zhi Ming Chng (Jim)
reviews.text: I was experiencing a persistent lower backache which did not resolve itself even with more rest for close to a month. Fortunately, I was referred to Issac who identified that my condition was due to a weak core and he treated me during my first visit, which alleviated the pain eventually. Issac also prepared and guided me through a series of exercises to strengthen my core and legs, which improved my condition subsequently with practice and so far there has been no relapses. This gave me confidence in Issac's expertise and I highly recommend Issac for all looking to improve your exercise forms and routine.
